product_overview: A modern web platform for Elilon Lopes Advogados to present the firm, publish legal content, capture leads, and provide an admin area for content and professional management.
core_goals: Present the firm's expertise and services to potential clients
Provide an accessible blog for legal articles to build authority
Capture and route client leads through contact and landing pages
Allow administrators to authenticate and manage content and professionals

features.name: Home Page
features.description: Public landing page that introduces the firm, highlights services, and provides quick access to contact options.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See firm overview and service highlights -> Use navigation to access other sections
Navigate to / -> Page fails to load or partial content loads -> See error or fallback content explaining the issue

features.name: Practice Areas
features.description: Page describing the firm's practice areas and service offerings for prospective clients.
user_flows: Navigate to /areas -> Read list of practice areas and descriptions -> Use navigation to contact or read related blog content
Navigate to /areas -> Content fetch fails or is missing -> See message indicating content is unavailable

features.name: Blog Browsing
features.description: Public blog listing where visitors can discover and read legal articles published by the firm.
user_flows: Navigate to /blog -> See list of articles with summaries -> Open an article from the list -> Read full article content
Navigate to /blog -> Article list fails to load due to server error -> See error message or retry option

features.name: Contact & Lead Capture
features.description: Contact page and lead capture form to allow visitors to send inquiries and generate leads for the firm.
user_flows: Navigate to /contato -> Fill contact form fields -> Submit contact form -> See submission confirmation and acknowledgement
Navigate to /contato -> Submit contact form with missing required fields -> See validation errors and remain on /contato
Navigate to /contato -> Submit contact form -> Backend network error occurs -> See submission failure message and retry option

features.name: Navigation View
features.description: Site-wide navigation that allows users to move between public pages quickly and reliably.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Use site navigation to go to /areas -> Use site navigation to go to /blog -> Use site navigation to go to /contato
Navigate to / -> Use site navigation while offline or when a route is unavailable -> See navigation fallback or error message

features.name: Admin Authentication and CMS Management
features.description: Protected admin area for authenticated users to manage blog posts and professionals; requires signing in and then provides CMS capabilities.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Submit login form -> Receive authentication token -> See admin dashboard and management sections
Navigate to /admin -> Fill email input field with incorrect credentials -> Fill password input field -> Submit login form -> Receive authentication error -> Remain on /admin with error visible
Navigate to /admin -> Authenticate successfully -> Open blog management section -> Create new blog post with title and content -> Submit new post -> See new post listed in admin blog management

Navigate to /admin -> Authenticate successfully -> Open professionals management section -> Create or edit a professional profile -> Save changes -> See updated professional listed in admin management
Navigate to /admin -> Authenticate successfully -> Attempt to save a post or profile -> Backend validation or network error occurs -> See error message and remain in management workflow

routes.description: Private admin dashboard to manage blog and professionals
